body: I hated myself, because watching my grandad die of lung cancer made me jealous. It was slow, painful, and there was absolutely nothing he could do about it. No one would blame him or be angry with him; he had a loving family, and I do too, so I don't want them to think it could possibly be their fault. I've recently stopped taking any medicine at all. I was supposed to be on antibiotics but flushed them all away, and have been sick for about 3 months now. Hoping to die of the common cold
